test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which political party was in power in England when the Cabinet Mission came to India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Labour Party.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Labour Party was in power from 1935 to 1955 in England when the Cabinet Mission came to India.
 
• Clement Attlee was the former Prime Minister of the United Kingdom. He served as the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 1945 to

 1951.
 
• Clement Attlee had declared India will get independence before June 1948. He declared that the British would quit India in June 1948 on February 20, 1947.
 
• Mountbatten arrived in India on 22 March 1947 as per the instruction of Clement Attlee.
 
• The Indian independence bill was introduced in Parliament on 4th July 1947.
 
• The Indian independence act was enacted on 18th July 1947.
 
• The Indian independence act came into force on 15th August 1947.
 
• He considered Indian independence as his finest achievement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Stafford Cripps and A. V. Alexander were members of the Cabinet Mission.
 
• John Major was a former Prime Minister of the United Kingdom. He served as the Leader of the Conservative Party from 1990 to 1997.
